anchors.0: Missing, broken, or no credible evidence.
anchors.1: Present only in a minimal or substantially incorrect form.
anchors.2: Partially complete with important fidelity or behavior gaps.
anchors.3: Strong and substantially complete, with limited visible gaps.
anchors.4: Exceptional fidelity and completeness against the supplied references.

1.name: Visual recreation
1.description: Scores hardware fidelity, visible feature coverage, interaction states, and implementation quality.

criteria.label: Silhouette and proportions
criteria.guidance: Compare the continuous red chassis, control-deck/keybed ratio, end cheeks, and overall 3:1 silhouette with the primary image.

criteria.label: Panel layout and density
criteria.guidance: Compare section landmarks first, then widths, spacing, grouping, density, and placement. Invented primary hardware such as OLEDs in Organ, Piano, or Effects prevents a rating above 1.

criteria.label: Control materials and color
criteria.guidance: Assess knobs, switches, drawbars, faders, LEDs, OLEDs, red metal, and inset slate panels.

criteria.label: Typography and displays
criteria.guidance: Assess legends, branding, hierarchy, display styling, and small-label legibility.

criteria.label: Visible hardware inventory
criteria.guidance: Check whether the reference's keys, controls, displays, dividers, pitch stick, and modulation control are represented in the correct sections. Penalize invented displays and generic repeated control matrices as structural errors.

criteria.label: Visual state coverage
criteria.guidance: Check illuminated, pressed, rotated, toggled, hover, and focus states across the visible hardware.

criteria.label: Control interaction
criteria.guidance: Exercise keys, buttons, knobs, LEDs, and displays; reward coherent feedback rather than decorative-only controls.

criteria.label: Responsive accessibility
criteria.guidance: Check supported viewport widths, clipping, keyboard focus, labels, touch targets, and reduced-motion behavior.

criteria.label: Component structure
criteria.guidance: Assess understandable React and CSS structure, reusable primitives, and data-driven repeated controls.

criteria.label: Runtime quality
criteria.guidance: Assess console cleanliness, stability, loading behavior, and avoidable rendering or layout problems.

2.name: Piano instrument
2.description: Scores Phase 1 retention, piano feature coverage, audio behavior, playability, and implementation quality.

criteria.label: Reference fidelity retention
criteria.guidance: Confirm the Phase 1 chassis, layout, controls, materials, and display fidelity were preserved while adding audio.

criteria.label: Responsive chassis
criteria.guidance: Check the connected chassis, complete 73-key layout, scaling, clipping, and absence of accidental gutters.

criteria.label: Input coverage
criteria.guidance: Verify mouse, touch, computer keyboard, and Web MIDI paths, including graceful permission or availability states.

criteria.label: Piano controls
criteria.guidance: Verify master volume, piano parameters, sustain, reverb, and relevant panel controls affect the engine.

criteria.label: Display and status feedback
criteria.guidance: Verify piano selection, parameters, active notes, MIDI/audio readiness, and errors are communicated in the UI.

criteria.label: Piano sound source
criteria.guidance: Assess whether the piano uses credible samples or a comparably convincing implementation rather than a placeholder oscillator.

criteria.label: Note lifecycle
criteria.guidance: Check attack, release, repeated notes, stuck-note prevention, all-notes-off, and overlapping note behavior.

criteria.label: Velocity response
criteria.guidance: Check meaningful velocity response from supported inputs and an appropriate dynamic range.

criteria.label: Sustain and polyphony
criteria.guidance: Check sustain-pedal semantics, held/released note transitions, useful polyphony, and voice cleanup.

criteria.label: Playability
criteria.guidance: Assess perceived latency, reliable note triggering, key mapping, multi-touch behavior, and sustained play.

criteria.label: Control feedback
criteria.guidance: Check that played notes and parameter changes produce immediate visual and audible feedback.

criteria.label: Failure handling
criteria.guidance: Check denied MIDI, unavailable audio, asset failures, focus loss, and cleanup paths.

criteria.label: Audio architecture
criteria.guidance: Assess separation of UI, state, input handling, voice management, and the audio engine.

criteria.label: Performance and cleanup
criteria.guidance: Assess resource reuse, event cleanup, voice disposal, render stability, and browser-console cleanliness.

3.name: Complete instrument
3.description: Scores full-system feature coverage, engine and effect behavior, visual retention, routing, and architecture.

criteria.label: Reference fidelity retention
criteria.guidance: Compare the final instrument against the primary image and confirm prior visual quality has not regressed.

criteria.label: Hardware state fidelity
criteria.guidance: Assess whether active engines, layers, effects, morphs, splits, and menus are reflected through credible hardware states.

criteria.label: Instrument engines
criteria.guidance: Verify meaningful Piano, Organ, and Synth implementations with selectable and editable behavior.

criteria.label: Effects coverage
criteria.guidance: Verify the required effects exist, alter sound meaningfully, expose appropriate controls, and can be enabled or bypassed.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, and morphs
criteria.guidance: Verify layer focus and levels, keyboard zones and splits, and morph assignment behavior.

criteria.label: Presets and editing
criteria.guidance: Verify patch browsing, loading, saving, parameter editing, and state restoration.

criteria.label: Engine behavior
criteria.guidance: Assess the musical usefulness and distinct behavior of the Piano, Organ, and Synth engines.

criteria.label: Effect routing
criteria.guidance: Check serial/parallel routing, per-layer targeting, dry/wet behavior, bypass, gain staging, and interactions between effects.

criteria.label: Quality and latency
criteria.guidance: Assess noise, clipping, clicks, voice handling, latency, CPU stability, and consistency during layered play.

criteria.label: Hardware control mapping
criteria.guidance: Check that visible hardware controls have meaningful, discoverable behavior with correct focus and targeting.

criteria.label: Menus and displays
criteria.guidance: Verify navigation, contextual displays, parameter editing, and menu state transitions.

criteria.label: State and routing
criteria.guidance: Exercise layers, zones, focus, engine assignments, effect assignments, and preset transitions as one coherent system.

criteria.label: Regression resistance
criteria.guidance: Confirm Phase 1 interactions and Phase 2 piano behavior remain functional in the final instrument.

criteria.label: System architecture
criteria.guidance: Assess engine boundaries, state ownership, routing abstractions, component composition, and extensibility.

criteria.label: Maintainability
criteria.guidance: Assess naming, modularity, duplication, documentation, and the clarity of complex state transitions.

criteria.label: Reliability and performance
criteria.guidance: Assess console cleanliness, cleanup, rendering stability, audio performance, and behavior under rapid interaction.
